messages:
Lena: Quick poll idea
Whos up for an ugly sweater + holiday card photo roulette? We spin names and you send a goofy pic to your match. Winner gets top shelf cookie pack. :sweater:
Chris: 100% yes. Rules?
Lena: Keep it PG, no Photoshop blackmail, and send cards by Dec 20. Optional theme: 'tech holiday' (think tiny servers wearing scarves).
Anika: Love it. Can we add a tiny kudos note to the card? quick line about something you appreciated this year.
Ben: Count me in. Also can someone grab a table for the photo booth prop stash?
SnackBot: Heads up: Snack closet open at 2pm today. Holiday granola tins restocked. :cookie:
Chris: I volunteer to run the random draw (I'm allergic to spreadsheets but I have a hat)
Lena: Amazing. @Chris post the list here when you spin, and @Ben will collect props from the supply closet.
Chris: Spun! Pairings: Lena -> Anika, Chris -> Ben, Anika -> Chris, Ben -> Lena. (posted privately too)
Anika: Omg Im sending a 90s webcam selfie with a tinsel halo. Also kudos to @Lena for keeping the cross-team retro short and useful.
Ben: Meme incoming: "When the model predicts holiday cheer but you only fed it eggnog" + tiny GIF. :laughing:
Lena: Haha. Reminder: photo booth will be in the common area from 4-6pm Fri. Bring retro sweaters, ugly ties, and your best fake snow.
SnackBot: Reminder: Please label allergens on shared snacks. Also office holiday playlist now open for requests (drop songs below). :musical_note:
Chris: Dropping a song: "Fairytale of New York" (controversial but iconic)
Anika: Adding "Last Christmas" :heart:
Ben: Quick kudos  shoutout to @Chris for staying late to help with the bench infra tests last sprint.
Lena: Love the energy. Also if anyone needs a physical card printed, ping me - I can do a small run.
Chris: :snowflake: for best planner vibes (to @Lena)
Anika: :snowflake: to @Chris for the pairing and hat commitment
Ben: :snowflake: to @Anika for the retro shoutout and comedic tinsel halo promise
Lena: OK locking this for logistics at 5pm PT. If you missed signups DM @Chris. Happy almost-holidays y'all 389
